home.heroEnglish: Researching School Accessibility and Advancing Inclusive Education in Patna, Bihar.
home.introText: Sugamya Shiksha Bihar is a dedicated research and resource platform. Grounded in Patna district, this project documents physical infrastructure barriers in schools, evaluates compliance with national universal design standards, and amplifies community voices for inclusive education.

objectives.title: Evaluate Physical Accessibility
objectives.desc: Systematic on-site audits of ramps, accessible toilets, door widths, pathways, tactile indicators, and emergency exits across schools in Patna.

objectives.title: Bridge Policy & Practice
objectives.desc: Translate the Accessibility Code for Educational Institutions 2024 and RPwD Act 2016 into clear, actionable checklists for educators and administrators.

objectives.title: Foster Community Action
objectives.desc: Empower parents, students with disabilities, and teachers to report barriers and record lived experiences with dignity and strict consent.

objectives.title: Measure Visible Change
objectives.desc: Track tangible physical improvements through a verified Before & After tracker to foster institutional accountability.

home.campaignSubtitle: Building understanding and community mobilisation for barrier-free schools across Bihar.

campaignItems.title: What Makes a School Ramp Usable?
campaignItems.desc: A visual guide illustrating the difference between a 1:12 gentle ramp with double handrails and an unsafe steep ramp.

campaignItems.title: Patna Educators Accessibility Dialogue
campaignItems.desc: Interactive workshop bringing together school principals and teachers on reasonable accommodation and basic modifications.

campaignItems.title: Understanding RPwD Act 2016 for Schools
campaignItems.desc: Short educational video with Hindi subtitles explaining the statutory obligation to make school buildings accessible.

activities.title: Initial Pilot Audits Commenced
activities.desc: Physical measurement audits began across 5 sample schools in Patna district using the digital audit framework.

activities.title: Accessibility Code 2024 Synthesis Published
activities.desc: Easy-Hindi summaries of school building norms published in the platform's Guidelines Library.

activities.title: Community Consultation with Parents & CwSN
activities.desc: Conducted consent-driven discussions on daily school transit and sanitation barriers faced by students.

guidelines.title: Laws, Policies & Accessibility Guidelines
guidelines.subtitle: Clear, accessible explanations of legal frameworks, building standards, and education policies governing inclusive schools.
guidelines.officialSourcesDesc: Authoritative primary sources and standards documents published by the Government of India and UNICEF.
